data.name: Jelle
data.gender_notes: Jelle is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jelle is derived from the Dutch word 'jelle', which is a diminutive of the name Gelre. Gelre is derived from the Germanic words 'gale' meaning 'healer' and 'rada' meaning 'counsel'. Therefore, Jelle can be interpreted as 'God's healer' or 'God's counselor'. The name Jelle carries the meaning “God's healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jelle usually hope their child will grow to embody god's healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
